# TypeGen - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: TypeGen
- Tagline: Infer TypeScript types from sample data.
- Domain: https://typegen.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- Paste JSON or CSV and TypeGen infers clean TypeScript interfaces (or a Zod schema), explains its assumptions, and flags ambiguous fields you should double-check.
- Sample data to TS types
- Interfaces / type aliases / Zod
- Explain inferred assumptions
- Flag ambiguous fields

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — 12 inferences/mo
- **Pro** — $19/mo — Unlimited, save history
- Checkout: https://typegen.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://typegen.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. Do I need to install anything?
A1. No. TypeGen runs in your browser.
Q2. Is my input kept private?
A2. We use it only to generate your result and minimize retention. See Security.
Q3. Does it guarantee compliance / correctness?
A3. No. It is decision-support; you own the final call. See the honesty note in Security.
Q4. Can I export the result?
A4. Yes — JSON and CSV.
Q5. Is there an API?
A5. Yes, the web form is backed by a REST endpoint you can call from your pipeline.
